scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull && pnpm install && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm --filter backend migration:run
scripts.sync:branch: git fetch origin && git merge --no-commit origin/main && pnpm install && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm --filter backend migration:run
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm --filter frontend format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
